description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class named CustomerOptionsValueController. It manages CRUD operations and UI interactions for customer option values within an e-commerce admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer option values.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling CRUD and UI interactions for customer option values in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayOptionValues
methods.description: Displays the list page for customer options values.

methods.name: displayOptionValueEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific customer option value identified by ID.

methods.name: displayOptionValueCreate
methods.description: Prepares and displays the creation form for a new customer option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Shared private method to initialize and prepare the model for creating or editing a customer option value.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a customer option value, including validation and persistence.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides paginated list of customer option values in JSON format for AJAX calls.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Removes a customer option value based on ID via AJAX call.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the correct menu context for UI rendering.
